The Future of Logistics and Technology in Portugal

A meeting point for innovation and technology in the logistics sector.

In an industry that is constantly evolving, staying up to date with the latest technological innovations is essential. This event has become a benchmark for professionals looking to explore new trends, share knowledge, and connect with industry experts.

More than just a gathering, this moment brings together visionary minds to discuss the future of logistics and the supply chain. With each edition, it reinforces its position as a unique opportunity for exchanging ideas and driving market growth.

What is TechLogistics?

TechLogistics is an innovative event dedicated to the intersection of technology, transport, and logistics.

Since its debut, it has been an essential platform for professionals and enthusiasts seeking knowledge, networking, and inspiration around the latest trends and advancements in the sector.

Following the success of previous editions, the 4th edition of TechLogistics promises an even more enriching experience, bringing together experts, companies, and innovators who are transforming logistics and the supply chain in Portugal.
